text.zh: 和 Jackie、Lynn 在伦敦东区同一所小学读书。
text.en: Attends a primary school in London's East End together with Jackie and Lynn.

text.zh: 她是独生女，说自己小时候很羡慕有兄弟姐妹的孩子。
text.en: She is an only child, and says she was jealous of children who had brothers and sisters.

text.zh: 在伦敦东区长大。
text.en: Growing up in London's East End.

text.zh: 7 岁加入本系列，以 Jackie 的朋友身份与同校的 Lynn 一同出镜。
text.en: Joins the series at seven, filmed as Jackie's friend alongside their schoolmate Lynn.

text.zh: 14 岁时她和 Jackie 在综合中学读书，Lynn 则上了文法学校。
text.en: At 14 she was at a comprehensive school, like Jackie, while Lynn was at a grammar school.

text.zh: 她从伦敦东区的小学升入综合中学，和 Jackie 一样。
text.en: She went from an East End primary school to a comprehensive, as did Jackie.

text.zh: 在一家旅行公司工作，为团体奖励旅游和会议预订海外酒店。
text.en: Works for a travel company, making bookings with hotels abroad for group incentive holidays and conferences.

text.zh: 她仍然单身，是三个朋友中唯一还没结婚的。
text.en: She is still single, the only one of the three friends not yet married.

text.zh: 被问是否想结婚，她说这问题很荒唐，并坚称自己没有在找丈夫。
text.en: Asked if she would like to be married, she called it a ridiculous question and said she was not looking for a husband.

text.zh: 她辞去了原来的工作，现在只做一份小小的兼职，说这对她已经足够。
text.en: Having given up her job, she now does a little part-time job, which she says is enough for her.

text.zh: 与煤气装修工 Billy 结婚四年，有一个两岁的儿子。
text.en: Married to Billy, a gas fitter, for four years, with a two-year-old son.

text.zh: 和丈夫住在伦敦东区的一套市政公房里。
text.en: Lives with her husband in a council house in London's East End.

text.zh: 24 岁时她嫁给了 Billy，并生下一个儿子。
text.en: She married Billy at 24 and had a son.

text.zh: 她觉得三人从七岁起就没变：她一直爱说话，Lynn 一直比较安静。
text.en: She feels the three friends have not changed since seven: she was always chatty, Lynn always the quieter one.

text.zh: 在一家住房互助协会做兼职；此前曾靠社会救济生活，她非常讨厌那段日子。
text.en: Works part-time for a building society, after a period living on social security, which she hated.

text.zh: 她已与 Billy 离婚，独自抚养两人的一儿一女。
text.en: Divorced from Billy, she is bringing up their son and daughter on her own.

text.zh: 上一部拍完后不久女儿出生；随后婚姻破裂，35 岁时她已离婚。
text.en: Her daughter was born just after the last film; the marriage then broke down, and by 35 she was divorced.

text.zh: 她说谈不上好日子：有两个可爱的孩子，却又站在十字路口，独自重新开始，只能去适应。
text.en: Not particularly good times, she says: two lovely children, but another crossroads, on her own and starting again, simply adapting.

text.zh: 重新全职工作，在伦敦大学 Queen Mary 学院法学院协助管理课程。
text.en: Back at work full-time, helping to run courses in the law faculty of Queen Mary College, University of London.

text.zh: 离婚后独自带大两个孩子；她有了新伴侣 Glenn，但她说“还早着呢”。
text.en: A single mother of two since her divorce, she has a new partner, Glenn, though it is 'early days yet'.

text.zh: 上一部之后，她重新开始全职工作，并与 Glenn 开始交往。
text.en: Since the last film she has gone back to full-time work and begun a relationship with Glenn.

text.zh: 她说孩子们的成长很多要归功于她的父母，他们“真的太好了”。
text.en: She says her children owe a lot to her mum and dad, who have been 'absolutely brilliant'.

text.zh: 现为伦敦大学法学院硕士项目的主要行政负责人，她很喜欢承担责任。
text.en: Now the main administrator of the MA programme in the University of London's law faculty; she loves the responsibility.

text.zh: 与 Glenn 订婚；两人和她的两个孩子住在他们一起买下的房子里。
text.en: Engaged to Glenn; they live with her two children in the house the couple bought together.

text.zh: 她已离开伦敦东区，搬进四个月前和 Glenn 一起买下的房子。
text.en: She has left the East End for a house she and Glenn bought together four months earlier.

text.zh: 她与 Glenn 订婚，两人合买了房子，她也搬离了伦敦东区。
text.en: She got engaged to Glenn, bought a house with him and moved out of the East End.

text.zh: 她觉得自己“天生就是担责任的料”，也承认感觉自己上了一个阶层。
text.en: She feels she was 'born for the responsibility', and supposes she has moved up a class.

text.zh: 她从没上过大学，如今却在大学里工作。
text.en: She never went to university, though she now works at one.

text.zh: 统筹 Queen Mary 法学院的整个研究生项目，她说自己真心喜欢这份工作。
text.en: Coordinates the whole postgraduate programme at Queen Mary's law school, a job she says she really enjoys.

text.zh: 与 Glenn 订婚约 14 年；女儿仍和她同住，儿子在外租房。
text.en: Engaged to Glenn for about 14 years; her daughter still lives with her, while her son rents.

text.zh: 上一部之后，邻居带她加入业余戏剧团，如今她登台演戏唱歌。
text.en: After the last film a neighbour drew her into an amateur drama group, and she now acts and sings on stage.

text.zh: 她觉得没必要后悔：事业不错，还将拥有自己的房子，这在她家是头一回。
text.en: She sees no point in regrets: she has had a good career and will own her home, a first for her family.

text.zh: 在 Queen Mary 已工作 20 年，现每周在家办公一天；她无法想象不工作。
text.en: Still at Queen Mary after 20 years, now working from home one day a week; she can't imagine not working.

text.zh: 与 Glenn 在一起二十多年，仍只是订婚；两个孩子都买了公寓，都还单身。
text.en: Together with Glenn for over 20 years and still engaged; both her children own flats and are single.

text.zh: 她提到经历了一些“医疗方面的可怕事”，Glenn 是她的依靠；母亲目前住院。
text.en: She mentions 'medical stuff and scary stuff', with Glenn as her rock; her mother is currently in hospital.

text.zh: 她说自己永远是工人阶级，并称参与这部系列片是一生的成就。
text.en: She says she will always be working class, and calls being part of the series a lifelong achievement.

text.zh: 在 Queen Mary 大学工作 25 年后不久前退休，她觉得退休生活很难适应。
text.en: Recently retired after 25 years at Queen Mary University of London, she is finding retirement hard.

text.zh: 2020 年底，她与相伴二十多年的 Glenn 结婚；两个孩子都已成年。
text.en: She married Glenn, her partner of more than 20 years, at the end of 2020; her two children are grown up.

text.zh: 住在罗姆福德（Romford）附近的 Gidea Park。
text.en: She lives in Gidea Park, near Romford.

text.zh: 2020 年底她与 Glenn 结婚；婚礼后父亲去世，两年后的节礼日母亲也离世。
text.en: She married Glenn in late 2020; her father died after the wedding, and her mother two years later, on Boxing Day.

text.zh: 她在伦敦从事大学行政工作 25 年后退休，2020 年终于与相伴二十多年的伴侣结婚，现居罗姆福德附近；她的父母都已去世。
text.en: Retired after 25 years in university administration in London, she finally married her partner of more than 20 years in 2020 and lives near Romford; both her parents have died.
